  const PARAM_BLOCKLIST = ['_gl','_ga','_gcl_au','_ga_C7SLJ6HMJ5','_gcl_aw','_gcl_dc'];
  const footerId = 'site-wide-footer';

    // De-linkify anchors so GTM/Optimizely/router can't navigate the iframe

      if (url) setTimeout(() => openExternal(url), 0);
      return false;
    };

    const onKey = function (e) {
      if (e.key !== 'Enter' && e.key !== ' ') return;
      const a = e.target.closest && e.target.closest('a, [role="link"]');
      if (!a || !footer.contains(a)) return;

class="SuperHubDoc-article3ArTrEavUTKg rm-Article rm-Guides-SuperHub"><header id="content-head"><div class="row clearfix"><div class="col-xs-9"><h1>Configured Commerce + Product Recommendations</h1><div class="excerpt"><div class="rm-Markdown markdown-body" data-testid="RDMD"><p>How to integrate Optimizely Configured Commerce with Optimizely Product Recommendations</p></div></div></div></div></header><div class="grid-container-fluid" id="content-container"><section class="content-body grid-75 "><div style="display:contents"><div class="rm-Markdown markdown-body rm-Markdown markdown-body ng-non-bindable" data-testid="RDMD" style="margin-left: 31px;"><style>/*! tailwindcss v4.1.17 | MIT License | https://tailwindcss.com */
@layer theme, base, components, utilities;
@layer utilities;
</style><style data-tailwind-stylesheet="true"></style><div class="readme-tailwind"><p>You can integrate Optimizely Configured Commerce and Optimizely Product Recommendations to increase user conversions.</p>
<blockquote class="callout callout_info" theme="📘"><span class="callout-icon">📘</span><h3 class="heading heading-3 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="note"></div><div class="heading-text">Note</div><a aria-label="Skip link to Note" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="#note"></a></h3><p>Optimizely includes the Product Recommendations JavaScript in the base themes and blueprints. You may need to manually add the <button aria-label="Copy Code" class="rdmd-code-copy fa"></button><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">peerius.js</span></code> file for custom themes and blueprints.</p></blockquote>
<h2 class="heading heading-2 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="generate-the-products-rss-feed-file-in-the-admin-console"></div><div class="heading-text">Generate the Products RSS Feed file in the Admin Console</div><a aria-label="Skip link to Generate the Products RSS Feed file in the Admin Console" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="#generate-the-products-rss-feed-file-in-the-admin-console"></a></h2>
<ol>
<li>
<p>Go to the Configured Commerce <strong>Admin Console > Administration > System > Settings</strong>.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Click the <strong>Integration</strong> tab, then go to <strong>Integration Connectors</strong>.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Toggle <strong>Enable Product Recommendations</strong> to <strong>Yes</strong>. This automatically creates two jobs: <strong>Export Products RSS Feed</strong> and <strong>Export Historical Orders</strong>.</p>
<p><span aria-label="Expand image" class="img lightbox closed" role="button" tabindex="0"><span class="lightbox-inner"><img alt="Enable Product Recommendations" class="img  " height="auto" loading="lazy" src="https://files.readme.io/a5f5b44b47fa9a3f7866ac6d1f23338508fd1bcf786e6481e622ee70a238c1f9-EnableProductRecs-2.png" title="" width="auto"></span></span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Go to <strong>Administration > Jobs > Job Definitions</strong>.</p>
<p><span aria-label="Expand image" class="img lightbox closed" role="button" tabindex="0"><span class="lightbox-inner"><img alt="Export Products RSS Feed Job" class="img  " height="auto" loading="lazy" src="https://files.readme.io/8af40765b56ba9c5dd0f6460708a2bce1a3488ac4f3e7f23bbefc27143f4605f-ExportProductsRSSFeed-2.png" title="" width="auto"></span></span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Click the <strong>Edit</strong> icon on the <strong>Export Products RSS Feed Job</strong>, and click <strong>More (...)</strong> to schedule the job. Remember to fill in the <strong>Website Name</strong> on the Schedule Job modal. Click <strong>Schedule Job</strong> when finished.</p>
<p><span aria-label="Expand image" class="img lightbox closed" role="button" tabindex="0"><span class="lightbox-inner"><img alt="Schedule Job" class="img  " height="auto" loading="lazy" src="https://files.readme.io/8c57722568a437c9074263205f13ad0c7e63be400bd332841f43259bb4874f71-ScheduleJob-2.png" title="" width="auto"></span></span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Go to <strong>Library > Media</strong> after you run the job, and open <strong>UserFiles > _system > ProductRecommendationFeed</strong>. Ensure that it contains a <button aria-label="Copy Code" class="rdmd-code-copy fa"></button><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">Products_RSS_Feed-{WebsiteName}.xml</span></code> file with your product data.</p>
<p><span aria-label="Expand image" class="img lightbox closed" role="button" tabindex="0"><span class="lightbox-inner"><img alt="Product Recommendations Feed" class="img  " height="auto" loading="lazy" src="https://files.readme.io/b6def278f8acc789d62eb1d90eb202506fe1c90a958bc295237e1d352a1947bf-ProductRecsFeed-2.png" title="" width="auto"></span></span></p>
</li>
</ol>
<h2 class="heading heading-2 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="import-your-products-rss-feed-file-to-the-product-recommendations-portal"></div><div class="heading-text">Import your Products RSS Feed file to the Product Recommendations portal</div><a aria-label="Skip link to Import your Products RSS Feed file to the Product Recommendations portal" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="#import-your-products-rss-feed-file-to-the-product-recommendations-portal"></a></h2>
<blockquote class="callout callout_info" theme="📘"><span class="callout-icon">📘</span><h3 class="heading heading-3 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="note-1"></div><div class="heading-text">Note</div><a aria-label="Skip link to Note" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="#note-1"></a></h3><p>You must work with your onboarding team to complete this step. If you are out of onboarding, email <a target="_self" href="mailto:support@optimizely.com">support@optimizely.com</a> and CC your Customer Success Manager.</p></blockquote>
<ol>
<li>
<p>Go to the Product Recommendations portal and click <strong>Admin > Site Management > Feed configuration > Configure</strong>.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Set <strong>Feed type</strong> to <strong>Generic download</strong>.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Enter <button aria-label="Copy Code" class="rdmd-code-copy fa"></button><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">{your_site_url}/api/v1/productsrssfeed</span></code> in the <strong>Feed URL field</strong>.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Select your <strong>Default location</strong>. In general, select the language code for the default website language.</p>
<p><span aria-label="Expand image" class="img lightbox closed" role="button" tabindex="0"><span class="lightbox-inner"><img alt="Configure Feed" class="img  " height="auto" loading="lazy" src="https://files.readme.io/aff68ffce687e46f4def186d41a62bdf749a5437000f89daf614b47ad68e88bb-configcommprodrecs5.png" title="" width="auto"></span></span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Select the <strong>History</strong> tab and click <strong>Run feed</strong>.</p>
<p><span aria-label="Expand image" class="img lightbox closed" role="button" tabindex="0"><span class="lightbox-inner"><img alt="Run Feed History" class="img  " height="auto" loading="lazy" src="https://files.readme.io/9ee7c287db97bfdef7d8342149c977b0b31006faeb532d9bcea086907b3be519-configcommprodrecs6.png" title="" width="auto"></span></span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Select your site from the modal that appears, then click <strong>Run feed</strong> again.</p>
<p><span aria-label="Expand image" class="img lightbox closed" role="button" tabindex="0"><span class="lightbox-inner"><img alt="Select Site for Feed" class="img  " height="auto" loading="lazy" src="https://files.readme.io/1271d035834b8318bbfd7c1d39597ea436aada871232c3097cfe239c7e4ec2ca-configcommprodrecs7.png" title="" width="auto"></span></span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Wait for the feed to import successfully. If the import fails, check the error message and contact Optimizely support.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Set a schedule for the feed to run. Optimizely recommends having the feed run daily 15-30 minutes after the feed updates from Configured Commerce.</p>
<p><span aria-label="Expand image" class="img lightbox closed" role="button" tabindex="0"><span class="lightbox-inner"><img alt="Set Schedule" class="img  " height="auto" loading="lazy" src="https://files.readme.io/d5a2e6fc4dcc0be7855722abc2f969addd89ce123f965a791638b296d206783a-SetSchedule.png" title="" width="auto"></span></span></p>
<p><span aria-label="Expand image" class="img lightbox closed" role="button" tabindex="0"><span class="lightbox-inner"><img alt="Schedule Configuration" class="img  " height="auto" loading="lazy" src="https://files.readme.io/6845f1c869d23f7223aa64df17626455fd0170a9ea725c14dbac84451de2fb7c-Schedule.png" title="" width="auto"></span></span></p>
</li>
</ol>
<h2 class="heading heading-2 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="configure-tracking-in-the-product-recommendations-portal"></div><div class="heading-text">Configure tracking in the Product Recommendations portal</div><a aria-label="Skip link to Configure tracking in the Product Recommendations portal" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="#configure-tracking-in-the-product-recommendations-portal"></a></h2>
<blockquote class="callout callout_info" theme="📘"><span class="callout-icon">📘</span><h3 class="heading heading-3 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="note-2"></div><div class="heading-text">Note</div><a aria-label="Skip link to Note" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="#note-2"></a></h3><p>You must work with your onboarding team to complete this step. If you are out of onboarding, email <a target="_self" href="mailto:support@optimizely.com">support@optimizely.com</a> and CC your Customer Success Manager.</p></blockquote>
<ol>
<li>
<p>Go to <strong>Admin > Tracking > Domains</strong>.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Click <strong>Add Domain</strong> and input your site domain. Do not add <button aria-label="Copy Code" class="rdmd-code-copy fa"></button><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">https://</span></code> or <button aria-label="Copy Code" class="rdmd-code-copy fa"></button><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">www</span></code>.</p>
<p><span aria-label="Expand image" class="img lightbox closed" role="button" tabindex="0"><span class="lightbox-inner"><img alt="Add Domain" class="img  " height="auto" loading="lazy" src="https://files.readme.io/5577f672562b80de5363c6bbcf36514ab99e36adec5f8bb1b5e090f5f77ffe0a-AddDomain.png" title="" width="auto"></span></span></p>
<p><span aria-label="Expand image" class="img lightbox closed" role="button" tabindex="0"><span class="lightbox-inner"><img alt="List of Domains" class="img  " height="auto" loading="lazy" src="https://files.readme.io/0e9effbcdb688709e187cf6fa0755c6be130a11d6b09a79853da92143c1fcf27-List_of_Domains.png" title="" width="auto"></span></span></p>
<p>Your domain is now whitelisted and can receive tracking requests.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Go to the <strong>Script</strong> tab.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Ensure <strong>Tracking script type</strong> is set to <strong>Generic format</strong>.</p>
</li>
</ol>
<p>You should now have tracking and your feed setup. These are the two fundamental requirements for Product Recommendations to work. You can now create widgets for the website and adjust the strategies to reflect the recommendations for your customers.</p>
<h2 class="heading heading-2 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="configure-tracking-in-the-admin-console"></div><div class="heading-text">Configure tracking in the Admin Console</div><a aria-label="Skip link to Configure tracking in the Admin Console" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="#configure-tracking-in-the-admin-console"></a></h2>
<p>After creating the feed, you must adjust a few settings to ensure tracking works as intended.</p>
<span aria-label="Expand image" class="img lightbox closed" role="button" tabindex="0"><span class="lightbox-inner"><img alt="Product Recommendations Settings" class="img  " height="auto" loading="lazy" src="https://files.readme.io/9422a1a7a0abf3a89d0a68b14cc0de03922a2eb1b40a5bd7d6cac05fef2001a7-ProductRecsSettings-2.png" title="" width="auto"></span></span>
<p>You should update three areas:</p>
<ul>
<li>
<p><strong>Peerius Tracking URL</strong> — This depends on your environment.</p>
<ul>
<li><strong>UAT</strong> — <button aria-label="Copy Code" class="rdmd-code-copy fa"></button><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">//<sitename>.uat.productrecs.optimizely.com/tracker/peerius.page</span></code></li>
<li><strong>PROD (SE)</strong> — <button aria-label="Copy Code" class="rdmd-code-copy fa"></button><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">//<sitename>.peerius.episerver.net/tracker/peerius.page</span></code></li>
<li><strong>PROD (US)</strong> — <button aria-label="Copy Code" class="rdmd-code-copy fa"></button><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">//<sitename>.uswe01.productrecs.episerver.net/tracker/peerius.page</span></code></li>
</ul>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Peerius Site Name</strong> — This is the name given to your Product Recommendation instance. You can find this in the Product Recommendatons portal.</p>
<p><span aria-label="Expand image" class="img lightbox closed" role="button" tabindex="0"><span class="lightbox-inner"><img alt="Peerius Site Name" class="img  " height="auto" loading="lazy" src="https://files.readme.io/ed12a3456883e8fbf7b29fa613c118dc104ee72d3ec13756b057aa12cecf06b3-PeeriusSiteName-2.png" title="" width="auto"></span></span></p>
<p>This example has datademosite2 as the Site Name.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p><strong>Peerius API Version</strong> — This should always be <strong>v1_4</strong>.</p>
</li>
</ul>
<p>After saving the settings, check your evironments to see if tracking is live.</p>
<ol>
<li>Go to your website.</li>
<li>Open up the developer console and go to the <strong>Network</strong> tab.</li>
<li>Search for <em>peerius</em> and hit refresh. You should see <button aria-label="Copy Code" class="rdmd-code-copy fa"></button><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">peerius.page</span></code>. You can also go to the <strong>Sources</strong> tab and look for <button aria-label="Copy Code" class="rdmd-code-copy fa"></button><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter"><sitename>.uat.productrecs</span></code>, <button aria-label="Copy Code" class="rdmd-code-copy fa"></button><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter"><sitename>.uswe01</span></code>, or <button aria-label="Copy Code" class="rdmd-code-copy fa"></button><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter"><sitename>.peerius.episerver</span></code>. You should see <button aria-label="Copy Code" class="rdmd-code-copy fa"></button><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">peerius.page</span></code>, <button aria-label="Copy Code" class="rdmd-code-copy fa"></button><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">tracker.page</span></code>, and <button aria-label="Copy Code" class="rdmd-code-copy fa"></button><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">trackerform.page</span></code>.</li>
</ol>
<p>If you do not see tracking, contact your dedicated onboarding team. If you are out of onboarding, email <a target="_self" href="mailto:support@optimizely.com">support@optimizely.com</a> and CC your Customer Success Manager.</p>
<h2 class="heading heading-2 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="configure-widgets-in-the-product-recommendations-portal"></div><div class="heading-text">Configure widgets in the Product Recommendations portal</div><a aria-label="Skip link to Configure widgets in the Product Recommendations portal" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="#configure-widgets-in-the-product-recommendations-portal"></a></h2>
<ol>
<li>
<p>Go to the Product Recommendations portal and click <strong>Configuration > Product Recommendations > Widgets</strong> and <a target="_self" href="https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/29276227082893-Manage-widgets">create your desired widgets</a>.</p>
<p><span aria-label="Expand image" class="img lightbox closed" role="button" tabindex="0"><span class="lightbox-inner"><img alt="Configure Widgets" class="img  " height="auto" loading="lazy" src="https://files.readme.io/e5a08a17ba5ce405c7dc85fa0e90dceba1aa2aba16b8158d60eab2bc54a85ed8-configcommprodrecs8.png" title="" width="auto"></span></span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Go to <strong>Widgets per page</strong> and assign widgets to the relevant pages.</p>
<p><span aria-label="Expand image" class="img lightbox closed" role="button" tabindex="0"><span class="lightbox-inner"><img alt="Widgets per Page" class="img  " height="auto" loading="lazy" src="https://files.readme.io/e6d4edaaba35be8edba4bee9f90fe2c1d77370389243b8fc9b1e7b89f4b41588-configcommprodrecs9.png" title="" width="auto"></span></span></p>
</li>
</ol>
<h2 class="heading heading-2 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="configure-recommended-product-widgets-in-classic-cms"></div><div class="heading-text">Configure Recommended Product widgets in Classic CMS</div><a aria-label="Skip link to Configure Recommended Product widgets in Classic CMS" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="#configure-recommended-product-widgets-in-classic-cms"></a></h2>
<ol>
<li>Go to the Configured Commerce Classic CMS by adding <button aria-label="Copy Code" class="rdmd-code-copy fa"></button><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">/contentadmin</span></code> to the end of your site URL or by selecting <strong>Content Editor (CMS)</strong> from the Dashboard in the Admin Console.</li>
<li>Click the <strong>Edit</strong> icon.</li>
<li>Select a page in the page tree.</li>
<li>Click <strong>Add Content</strong>.</li>
<li>Select the <strong>Recommended Products</strong> widget.</li>
<li>Choose the <strong>Number of Products to Display</strong>.</li>
<li>Set the <strong>Product Information to Display</strong>, the positioning, or other settings as desired.</li>
<li>Click <strong>Save</strong>, then click <strong>Publish</strong>.</li>
</ol>
<h2 class="heading heading-2 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="configure-product-recommendations-carousel-widgets-in-spire-cms"></div><div class="heading-text">Configure Product Recommendations carousel widgets in Spire CMS</div><a aria-label="Skip link to Configure Product Recommendations carousel widgets in Spire CMS" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="#configure-product-recommendations-carousel-widgets-in-spire-cms"></a></h2>
<ol>
<li>
<p>Go to the Configured Commerce Spire CMS by adding <button aria-label="Copy Code" class="rdmd-code-copy fa"></button><code class="rdmd-code lang-undefined theme-light"><span class="cm-s-neo" data-testid="SyntaxHighlighter">/contentadmin</span></code> to the end of your site URL or by selecting <strong>Content Editor (CMS)</strong> from the Dashboard in the Admin Console.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Click the <strong>Edit</strong> icon.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Select a page in the page tree.</p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Click <strong>Add Widget</strong>, then select <a target="_self" href="https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/9478797427725-Common-Elements-widgets#h_01HAW7BJCMMQKABHYAZ14SDD0T">Product Carousel</a>.</p>
<p><span aria-label="Expand image" class="img lightbox closed" role="button" tabindex="0"><span class="lightbox-inner"><img alt="Product Carousel Widget" class="img  " height="auto" loading="lazy" src="https://files.readme.io/ababc2cd58eab7de67ede6ab41e0e1dffd703e504300353f5c6aaf048ce396f1-ProductCarouselWidget-2.png" title="" width="auto"></span></span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Select <strong>Recommended Products</strong> for <strong>Carousel Type</strong>. You can also change the <strong>Widget Position</strong> if you plan to use several Product Recommendations widgets.</p>
<p><span aria-label="Expand image" class="img lightbox closed" role="button" tabindex="0"><span class="lightbox-inner"><img alt="Configure Product Carousel" class="img  " height="auto" loading="lazy" src="https://files.readme.io/8ed774d0c26e68651cb5395a40cc4022fc2b19d11a5a817a51235b47e1374ca3-configcommprodrecs11.png" title="" width="auto"></span></span></p>
</li>
<li>
<p>Click <strong>Save</strong>, then click <strong>Publish</strong>.</p>
</li>
</ol>
<blockquote class="callout callout_info" theme="📘"><span class="callout-icon">📘</span><h3 class="heading heading-3 header-scroll"><div class="heading-anchor anchor waypoint" id="note-3"></div><div class="heading-text">Note</div><a aria-label="Skip link to Note" class="heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor" href="#note-3"></a></h3><p>If you have multiple widgets on a page, such as on a product detail page, set the second widget's position to <strong>2</strong>.</p></blockquote></div>

utilities;\n@layer utilities;\n\u003c/style>\u003cdiv class=\"readme-tailwind\">\u003cp>You can integrate Optimizely Configured Commerce and Optimizely Product Recommendations to increase user conversions.\u003c/p>\n\u003cblockquote class=\"callout callout_info\" theme=\"📘\">\u003cspan class=\"callout-icon\">📘\u003c/span>\u003ch3 class=\"heading heading-3 header-scroll\">\u003cdiv class=\"heading-anchor anchor waypoint\" id=\"note\">\u003c/div>\u003cdiv class=\"heading-text\">Note\u003c/div>\u003ca aria-label=\"Skip link to Note\" class=\"heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor\" href=\"#note\">\u003c/a>\u003c/h3>\u003cp>Optimizely includes the Product Recommendations JavaScript in the base themes and blueprints. You may need to manually add the \u003ccode class=\"rdmd-code lang- theme-undefined\" data-lang=\"\">peerius.js\u003c/code> file for custom themes and blueprints.\u003c/p>\u003c/blockquote>\n\u003ch2 class=\"heading heading-2 header-scroll\">\u003cdiv class=\"heading-anchor anchor waypoint\" id=\"generate-the-products-rss-feed-file-in-the-admin-console\">\u003c/div>\u003cdiv class=\"heading-text\">Generate the Products RSS Feed file in the Admin Console\u003c/div>\u003ca aria-label=\"Skip link to Generate the Products RSS Feed file in the Admin Console\" class=\"heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor\" href=\"#generate-the-products-rss-feed-file-in-the-admin-console\">\u003c/a>\u003c/h2>\n\u003col>\n\u003cli>\n\u003cp>Go to the Configured Commerce \u003cstrong>Admin Console > Administration > System > Settings\u003c/strong>.\u003c/p>\n\u003c/li>\n\u003cli>\n\u003cp>Click the \u003cstrong>Integration\u003c/strong> tab, then go to \u003cstrong>Integration Connectors\u003c/strong>.\u003c/p>\n\u003c/li>\n\u003cli>\n\u003cp>Toggle \u003cstrong>Enable Product Recommendations\u003c/strong> to \u003cstrong>Yes\u003c/strong>. This automatically creates two jobs: \u003cstrong>Export Products RSS Feed\u003c/strong> and \u003cstrong>Export Historical Orders\u003c/strong>.\u003c/p>\n\u003cp>\u003cspan aria-label=\"Expand image\" class=\"img lightbox closed\" role=\"button\" tabindex=\"0\">\u003cspan class=\"lightbox-inner\">\u003cimg alt=\"Enable Product Recommendations\" class=\"img  \" height=\"auto\" loading=\"lazy\" src=\"https://files.readme.io/a5f5b44b47fa9a3f7866ac6d1f23338508fd1bcf786e6481e622ee70a238c1f9-EnableProductRecs-2.png\" title=\"\" width=\"auto\"/>\u003c/span>\u003c/span>\u003c/p>\n\u003c/li>\n\u003cli>\n\u003cp>Go to \u003cstrong>Administration > Jobs > Job Definitions\u003c/strong>.\u003c/p>\n\u003cp>\u003cspan aria-label=\"Expand image\" class=\"img lightbox closed\" role=\"button\" tabindex=\"0\">\u003cspan class=\"lightbox-inner\">\u003cimg alt=\"Export Products RSS Feed Job\" class=\"img  \" height=\"auto\" loading=\"lazy\" src=\"https://files.readme.io/8af40765b56ba9c5dd0f6460708a2bce1a3488ac4f3e7f23bbefc27143f4605f-ExportProductsRSSFeed-2.png\" title=\"\" width=\"auto\"/>\u003c/span>\u003c/span>\u003c/p>\n\u003c/li>\n\u003cli>\n\u003cp>Click the \u003cstrong>Edit\u003c/strong> icon on the \u003cstrong>Export Products RSS Feed Job\u003c/strong>, and click \u003cstrong>More (...)\u003c/strong> to schedule the job. Remember to fill in the \u003cstrong>Website Name\u003c/strong> on the Schedule Job modal. Click \u003cstrong>Schedule Job\u003c/strong> when finished.\u003c/p>\n\u003cp>\u003cspan aria-label=\"Expand image\" class=\"img lightbox closed\" role=\"button\" tabindex=\"0\">\u003cspan class=\"lightbox-inner\">\u003cimg alt=\"Schedule Job\" class=\"img  \" height=\"auto\" loading=\"lazy\" src=\"https://files.readme.io/8c57722568a437c9074263205f13ad0c7e63be400bd332841f43259bb4874f71-ScheduleJob-2.png\" title=\"\" width=\"auto\"/>\u003c/span>\u003c/span>\u003c/p>\n\u003c/li>\n\u003cli>\n\u003cp>Go to \u003cstrong>Library > Media\u003c/strong> after you run the job, and open \u003cstrong>UserFiles > _system > ProductRecommendationFeed\u003c/strong>. Ensure that it contains a \u003ccode class=\"rdmd-code lang- theme-undefined\" data-lang=\"\">Products_RSS_Feed-{WebsiteName}.xml\u003c/code> file with your product data.\u003c/p>\n\u003cp>\u003cspan aria-label=\"Expand image\" class=\"img lightbox closed\" role=\"button\" tabindex=\"0\">\u003cspan class=\"lightbox-inner\">\u003cimg alt=\"Product Recommendations Feed\" class=\"img  \" height=\"auto\" loading=\"lazy\" src=\"https://files.readme.io/b6def278f8acc789d62eb1d90eb202506fe1c90a958bc295237e1d352a1947bf-ProductRecsFeed-2.png\" title=\"\" width=\"auto\"/>\u003c/span>\u003c/span>\u003c/p>\n\u003c/li>\n\u003c/ol>\n\u003ch2 class=\"heading heading-2 header-scroll\">\u003cdiv class=\"heading-anchor anchor waypoint\" id=\"import-your-products-rss-feed-file-to-the-product-recommendations-portal\">\u003c/div>\u003cdiv class=\"heading-text\">Import your Products RSS Feed file to the Product Recommendations portal\u003c/div>\u003ca aria-label=\"Skip link to Import your Products RSS Feed file to the Product Recommendations portal\" class=\"heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor\" href=\"#import-your-products-rss-feed-file-to-the-product-recommendations-portal\">\u003c/a>\u003c/h2>\n\u003cblockquote class=\"callout callout_info\" theme=\"📘\">\u003cspan class=\"callout-icon\">📘\u003c/span>\u003ch3 class=\"heading heading-3 header-scroll\">\u003cdiv class=\"heading-anchor anchor waypoint\" id=\"note-1\">\u003c/div>\u003cdiv class=\"heading-text\">Note\u003c/div>\u003ca aria-label=\"Skip link to Note\" class=\"heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor\" href=\"#note-1\">\u003c/a>\u003c/h3>\u003cp>You must work with your onboarding team to complete this step. If you are out of onboarding, email \u003ca href=\"mailto:support@optimizely.com\" target=\"\" title=\"\">support@optimizely.com\u003c/a> and CC your Customer Success Manager.\u003c/p>\u003c/blockquote>\n\u003col>\n\u003cli>\n\u003cp>Go to the Product Recommendations portal and click \u003cstrong>Admin > Site Management > Feed configuration > Configure\u003c/strong>.\u003c/p>\n\u003c/li>\n\u003cli>\n\u003cp>Set \u003cstrong>Feed type\u003c/strong> to \u003cstrong>Generic download\u003c/strong>.\u003c/p>\n\u003c/li>\n\u003cli>\n\u003cp>Enter \u003ccode class=\"rdmd-code lang- theme-undefined\" data-lang=\"\">{your_site_url}/api/v1/productsrssfeed\u003c/code> in the \u003cstrong>Feed URL field\u003c/strong>.\u003c/p>\n\u003c/li>\n\u003cli>\n\u003cp>Select your \u003cstrong>Default location\u003c/strong>. In general, select the language code for the default website language.\u003c/p>\n\u003cp>\u003cspan aria-label=\"Expand image\" class=\"img lightbox closed\" role=\"button\" tabindex=\"0\">\u003cspan class=\"lightbox-inner\">\u003cimg alt=\"Configure Feed\" class=\"img  \" height=\"auto\" loading=\"lazy\" src=\"https://files.readme.io/aff68ffce687e46f4def186d41a62bdf749a5437000f89daf614b47ad68e88bb-configcommprodrecs5.png\" title=\"\" width=\"auto\"/>\u003c/span>\u003c/span>\u003c/p>\n\u003c/li>\n\u003cli>\n\u003cp>Select the \u003cstrong>History\u003c/strong> tab and click \u003cstrong>Run feed\u003c/strong>.\u003c/p>\n\u003cp>\u003cspan aria-label=\"Expand image\" class=\"img lightbox closed\" role=\"button\" tabindex=\"0\">\u003cspan class=\"lightbox-inner\">\u003cimg alt=\"Run Feed History\" class=\"img  \" height=\"auto\" loading=\"lazy\" src=\"https://files.readme.io/9ee7c287db97bfdef7d8342149c977b0b31006faeb532d9bcea086907b3be519-configcommprodrecs6.png\" title=\"\" width=\"auto\"/>\u003c/span>\u003c/span>\u003c/p>\n\u003c/li>\n\u003cli>\n\u003cp>Select your site from the modal that appears, then click \u003cstrong>Run feed\u003c/strong> again.\u003c/p>\n\u003cp>\u003cspan aria-label=\"Expand image\" class=\"img lightbox closed\" role=\"button\" tabindex=\"0\">\u003cspan class=\"lightbox-inner\">\u003cimg alt=\"Select Site for Feed\" class=\"img  \" height=\"auto\" loading=\"lazy\" src=\"https://files.readme.io/1271d035834b8318bbfd7c1d39597ea436aada871232c3097cfe239c7e4ec2ca-configcommprodrecs7.png\" title=\"\" width=\"auto\"/>\u003c/span>\u003c/span>\u003c/p>\n\u003c/li>\n\u003cli>\n\u003cp>Wait for the feed to import successfully. If the import fails, check the error message and contact Optimizely support.\u003c/p>\n\u003c/li>\n\u003cli>\n\u003cp>Set a schedule for the feed to run. Optimizely recommends having the feed run daily 15-30 minutes after the feed updates from Configured Commerce.\u003c/p>\n\u003cp>\u003cspan aria-label=\"Expand image\" class=\"img lightbox closed\" role=\"button\" tabindex=\"0\">\u003cspan class=\"lightbox-inner\">\u003cimg alt=\"Set Schedule\" class=\"img  \" height=\"auto\" loading=\"lazy\" src=\"https://files.readme.io/d5a2e6fc4dcc0be7855722abc2f969addd89ce123f965a791638b296d206783a-SetSchedule.png\" title=\"\" width=\"auto\"/>\u003c/span>\u003c/span>\u003c/p>\n\u003cp>\u003cspan aria-label=\"Expand image\" class=\"img lightbox closed\" role=\"button\" tabindex=\"0\">\u003cspan class=\"lightbox-inner\">\u003cimg alt=\"Schedule Configuration\" class=\"img  \" height=\"auto\" loading=\"lazy\" src=\"https://files.readme.io/6845f1c869d23f7223aa64df17626455fd0170a9ea725c14dbac84451de2fb7c-Schedule.png\" title=\"\" width=\"auto\"/>\u003c/span>\u003c/span>\u003c/p>\n\u003c/li>\n\u003c/ol>\n\u003ch2 class=\"heading heading-2 header-scroll\">\u003cdiv class=\"heading-anchor anchor waypoint\" id=\"configure-tracking-in-the-product-recommendations-portal\">\u003c/div>\u003cdiv class=\"heading-text\">Configure tracking in the Product Recommendations portal\u003c/div>\u003ca aria-label=\"Skip link to Configure tracking in the Product Recommendations portal\" class=\"heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor\" href=\"#configure-tracking-in-the-product-recommendations-portal\">\u003c/a>\u003c/h2>\n\u003cblockquote class=\"callout callout_info\" theme=\"📘\">\u003cspan class=\"callout-icon\">📘\u003c/span>\u003ch3 class=\"heading heading-3 header-scroll\">\u003cdiv class=\"heading-anchor anchor waypoint\" id=\"note-2\">\u003c/div>\u003cdiv class=\"heading-text\">Note\u003c/div>\u003ca aria-label=\"Skip link to Note\" class=\"heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor\" href=\"#note-2\">\u003c/a>\u003c/h3>\u003cp>You must work with your onboarding team to complete this step. If you are out of onboarding, email \u003ca href=\"mailto:support@optimizely.com\" target=\"\" title=\"\">support@optimizely.com\u003c/a> and CC your Customer Success Manager.\u003c/p>\u003c/blockquote>\n\u003col>\n\u003cli>\n\u003cp>Go to \u003cstrong>Admin > Tracking > Domains\u003c/strong>.\u003c/p>\n\u003c/li>\n\u003cli>\n\u003cp>Click \u003cstrong>Add Domain\u003c/strong> and input your site domain. Do not add \u003ccode class=\"rdmd-code lang- theme-undefined\" data-lang=\"\">https://\u003c/code> or \u003ccode class=\"rdmd-code lang- theme-undefined\" data-lang=\"\">www\u003c/code>.\u003c/p>\n\u003cp>\u003cspan aria-label=\"Expand image\" class=\"img lightbox closed\" role=\"button\" tabindex=\"0\">\u003cspan class=\"lightbox-inner\">\u003cimg alt=\"Add Domain\" class=\"img  \" height=\"auto\" loading=\"lazy\" src=\"https://files.readme.io/5577f672562b80de5363c6bbcf36514ab99e36adec5f8bb1b5e090f5f77ffe0a-AddDomain.png\" title=\"\" width=\"auto\"/>\u003c/span>\u003c/span>\u003c/p>\n\u003cp>\u003cspan aria-label=\"Expand image\" class=\"img lightbox closed\" role=\"button\" tabindex=\"0\">\u003cspan class=\"lightbox-inner\">\u003cimg alt=\"List of Domains\" class=\"img  \" height=\"auto\" loading=\"lazy\" src=\"https://files.readme.io/0e9effbcdb688709e187cf6fa0755c6be130a11d6b09a79853da92143c1fcf27-List_of_Domains.png\" title=\"\" width=\"auto\"/>\u003c/span>\u003c/span>\u003c/p>\n\u003cp>Your domain is now whitelisted and can receive tracking requests.\u003c/p>\n\u003c/li>\n\u003cli>\n\u003cp>Go to the \u003cstrong>Script\u003c/strong> tab.\u003c/p>\n\u003c/li>\n\u003cli>\n\u003cp>Ensure \u003cstrong>Tracking script type\u003c/strong> is set to \u003cstrong>Generic format\u003c/strong>.\u003c/p>\n\u003c/li>\n\u003c/ol>\n\u003cp>You should now have tracking and your feed setup. These are the two fundamental requirements for Product Recommendations to work. You can now create widgets for the website and adjust the strategies to reflect the recommendations for your customers.\u003c/p>\n\u003ch2 class=\"heading heading-2 header-scroll\">\u003cdiv class=\"heading-anchor anchor waypoint\" id=\"configure-tracking-in-the-admin-console\">\u003c/div>\u003cdiv class=\"heading-text\">Configure tracking in the Admin Console\u003c/div>\u003ca aria-label=\"Skip link to Configure tracking in the Admin Console\" class=\"heading-anchor-icon fa fa-regular fa-anchor\" href=\"#configure-tracking-in-the-admin-console\">\u003c/a>\u003c/h2>\n\u003cp>After creating the feed, you must adjust a few settings to ensure tracking works as intended.\u003c/p>\n\u003cspan aria-label=\"Expand image\" class=\"img lightbox closed\" role=\"button\" tabindex=\"0\">\u003cspan class=\"lightbox-inner\">\u003cimg alt=\"Product Recommendations Settings\" class=\"img  \" height=\"auto\" loading=\"lazy\" src=\"https://files.readme.io/9422a1a7a0abf3a89d0a68b14cc0de03922a2eb1b40a5bd7d6cac05fef2001a7-ProductRecsSettings-2.png\" title=\"\" width=\"auto\"/>\u003c/span>\u003c/span>\n\u003cp>You should update three areas:\u003c/p>\n\u003cul>\n\u003cli>\n\u003cp>\u003cstrong>Peerius Tracking URL\u003c/strong> — This depends on your environment.\u003c/p>\n\u003cul>\n\u003cli>\u003cstrong>UAT\u003c/strong> — \u003ccode class=\"rdmd-code lang- theme-undefined\" data-lang=\"\">//<sitename>.uat.productrecs.optimizely.com/tracker/peerius.page\u003c/code>\u003c/li>\n\u003cli>\u003cstrong>PROD (SE)\u003c/strong> — \u003ccode class=\"rdmd-code lang- theme-undefined\" data-lang=\"\">//<sitename>.peerius.episerver.net/tracker/peerius.page\u003c/code>\u003c/li>\n\u003cli>\u003cstrong>PROD (US)\u003c/strong> — \u003ccode class=\"rdmd-code lang- theme-undefined\" data-lang=\"\">//<sitename>.uswe01.productrecs.episerver.net/tracker/peerius.page\u003c/code>\u003c/li>\n\u003c/ul>\n\u003c/li>\n\u003cli>\n\u003cp>\u003cstrong>Peerius Site Name\u003c/strong> — This is the name given to your Product Recommendation instance. You can find this in the Product Recommendatons portal.\u003c/p>\n\u003cp>\u003cspan aria-label=\"Expand image\" class=\"img lightbox closed\" role=\"button\" tabindex=\"0\">\u003cspan class=\"lightbox-inner\">\u003cimg alt=\"Peerius Site Name\" class=\"img  \" height=\"auto\" loading=\"lazy\" src=\"https://files.readme.io/ed12a3456883e8fbf7b29fa613c118dc104ee72d3ec13756b057aa12cecf06b3-PeeriusSiteName-2.png\" title=\"\" width=\"auto\"/>\u003c/span>\u003c/span>\u003c/p>\n\u003cp>This example has datademosite2 as the Site Name.\u003c/p>\n\u003c/li>\n\u003cli>\n\u003cp>\u003cstrong>Peerius API Version\u003c/strong> — This should always be \u003cstrong>v1_4\u003c/strong>.\u003c/p>\n\u003c/li>\n\u003c/ul>\n\u003cp>After saving the settings, check your evironments to see if tracking is live.\u003c/p>\n\u003col>\n\u003cli>Go to your website.\u003c/li>\n\u003cli>Open up the developer console and go to the \u003cstrong>Network\u003c/strong> tab.\u003c/li>\n\u003cli>Search for \u003cem>peerius\u003c/em> and hit refresh. You should see \u003ccode class=\"rdmd-code lang- theme-undefined\" data-lang=\"\">peerius.page\u003c/code>. You can also go to the \u003cstrong>Sources\u003c/strong> tab and look for \u003ccode class=\"rdmd-code lang- theme-undefined\" data-lang=\"\"><sitename>.uat.productrecs\u003c/code>, \u003ccode class=\"rdmd-code lang- theme-undefined\" data-lang=\"\"><sitename>.uswe01\u003c/code>, or \u003ccode class=\"rdmd-code lang- theme-undefined\" data-lang=\"\"><sitename>.peerius.episerver\u003c/code>.   if (!state.originalRemoveChild)  state.originalRemoveChild  = NP.removeChild;

  const _insertBefore = state.originalInsertBefore;
  const _removeChild  = state.originalRemoveChild;

  function isNotFound(err) {
    return !!(err && (err.name === 'NotFoundError' || err.code === 8));

=========================== */
function initNewTabEnforcer() {
  const isExternal = (href) => {
    try {
      const u = new URL(href, location.href);
      return u.origin !== location.origin;
    } catch { return false; }
  };

  const hardenAnchor = (a) => {
    if (!a || !a.href) return;
    if (!isExternal(a.href)) return;
    if (a.dataset.allowIframe != null || a.classList?.contains('allow-iframe')) return;
    a.target = '_blank';
    a.rel = 'noopener noreferrer';
    a.__newTabBound = true;
  };

  const scan = (root) => {
    if (!root) return;
    root.querySelectorAll?.('a[href]').forEach(hardenAnchor);
    root.querySelectorAll?.('*').forEach((el) => {
      if (el.shadowRoot) {
        try { el.shadowRoot.querySelectorAll('a[href]').forEach(hardenAnchor); } catch {}
        observe(el.shadowRoot);
      }
    });
  };

  const observe = (root) => {
    try {
      const mo = new MutationObserver(() => scan(root));
      mo.observe(root, { childList: true, subtree: true, attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['href'] });
      window.__aiSearchNewTabMOs = window.__aiSearchNewTabMOs || [];
      window.__aiSearchNewTabMOs.push(mo);
    } catch (e) {
      console.warn('[AI_SEARCH:newtab] observer error', e);
    }
  };

  const widget = document.querySelector('gen-search-widget');
  const containers = [widget, document].filter(Boolean);

  containers.forEach((c) => {
    scan(c instanceof Document ? c : (c.shadowRoot || c));
    observe(c instanceof Document ? c : (c.shadowRoot || c));
  });

  if (widget) {
    const tryLate = () => {
      scan(widget);
      if (widget.shadowRoot) scan(widget.shadowRoot);
    };
    setTimeout(tryLate, 250);
    setTimeout(tryLate, 1000);
    setTimeout(tryLate, 2000);
  }

  try { __DBG && __DBG('AI_SEARCH', 'initNewTabEnforcer attached'); } catch {}
}

// ---------------- Custom Download Spec File Button ----------------
(function () {
  /* ===== CONFIG ===== */
  const DEBUG = /\boasdebug=1\b/i.test(location.search);
  const FALLBACK_DELAY_MS = 5000;
  const log = (...a) => DEBUG && console.log('[oas-link]', ...a);

  /* ===== GUARD ===== */
  if (window.__OAS_DL_INIT__) return;
  window.__OAS_DL_INIT__ = true;

  /* ===== STATE ===== */
  const CACHE = new Map();
  let currentAbort = null;
  let runTimer     = null;
  let lastCtxKey   = null;
  let loadSeq      = 0;
  let activeCtxKey = null;
  let activeLoadId = null;
  const fbTimers   = new Map();

  /* ===== STYLES ===== */
  function ensureStyles() {
    if (document.getElementById('oas-link-style')) return;
    const s = document.createElement('style');
    s.id = 'oas-link-style';
    s.textContent = `
      #oas-slot{margin-top:10px}
      @keyframes oasSpin { to { transform: rotate(360deg); } }
      .oas-inline { display:inline-flex; align-items:center; gap:8px; font-size:13px; color:#4b5563; }
      .oas-spin { width:14px; height:14px; border-radius:50%;
                  border:2px solid #cbd5e1; border-top-color:#0037ff;
                  animation: oasSpin 0.8s linear infinite; }
      .oas-link-btn {
        display:inline-block;background-color:#0037ff!important;color:white!important;
        text-decoration:none!important;border:none!important;cursor:pointer!important;
        padding:10px 15px!important;font-size:14px!important;
        border-radius:5px!important;font-weight:bold!important;
      }
      #content-head.oas-loading [data-error-message="true"]{display:none!important}
    `;
    document.head.appendChild(s);
  }

  /* ===== DOM HELPERS ===== */
  const getHead      = () => document.querySelector('#content-head');
  const getH1        = () => document.querySelector('#content-head h1');
  const getHeaderRoot = () =>
    document.querySelector('header[data-raycast-oas]') ||
    getHead()?.closest('header') ||
    document.querySelector('header');

  function getSlot() {
    ensureStyles();
    const head = getHead();
    if (!head) return null;
    let slot = head.querySelector('#oas-slot');
    if (!slot) {
      slot = document.createElement('div');
      slot.id = 'oas-slot';
      const h1 = getH1();
      if (h1) h1.insertAdjacentElement('afterend', slot);
      else head.appendChild(slot);
    }
    return slot;
  }

  function removeSlot() {
    getHead()?.querySelector('#oas-slot')?.remove();
    setHeadState(null);
  }

  function setHeadState(state) {
    getHead()?.classList.toggle('oas-loading', state === 'loading');
  }

  /* ===== RENDER ===== */
  function renderLoading(loadId) {
    const slot = getSlot();
    if (!slot) return;
    if (slot.querySelector('[data-oas-loading]')?.getAttribute('data-oas-loading') === String(loadId)) return;
    if (slot.querySelector('[data-oas-link],[data-oas-msg]')) return;
    setHeadState('loading');
    slot.innerHTML = `
      <div class="oas-inline" data-oas-loading="${loadId}" aria-live="polite">
        <span class="oas-spin" aria-hidden="true"></span>
        <span>Resolving API spec…</span>
      </div>
    `;
  }

  function renderButton(result) {
    const slot = getSlot();
    if (!slot) return;
    setHeadState('ready');
    slot.innerHTML = `
      <a class="oas-link-btn" data-oas-link="true"
         href="${result.downloadUrl || result.url}"
         download="${result.filename}" rel="noopener">Download API spec</a>
    `;
  }

  function renderFallback() {
    const slot = getSlot();
    if (!slot) return;
    setHeadState('fallback');
    slot.innerHTML = `
      <div class="oas-inline" data-oas-msg="true">
        <span>Having trouble finding the proper spec? <a href="${projectRoot()}/openapi">View all API specs</a>.</span>
      </div>
    `;
  }

  function scheduleFallback(loadId) {
    cancelFallback(loadId);
    fbTimers.set(loadId, setTimeout(() => {
      const slot = getSlot();
      const cur = slot?.querySelector('[data-oas-loading]')?.getAttribute('data-oas-loading');
      if (cur === String(loadId) && !slot.querySelector('[data-oas-link]')) renderFallback();
    }, FALLBACK_DELAY_MS));
  }
  function cancelFallback(loadId) {
    clearTimeout(fbTimers.get(loadId));
    fbTimers.delete(loadId);
  }

  /* ===== CONTEXT ===== */
  const isInReference = () => location.pathname.includes('/reference/');
  const projectRoot   = () => location.pathname.replace(/\/reference.*/, '');
  const currentSlug   = () => (location.pathname.match(/\/reference\/([^/?#]+)/)||[])[1] || null;

  function readmeVersion() {
    const v = document.querySelector('meta[name="readme-version"]')?.content || '';
    if (!v || v === 'default') return null;
    return v.startsWith('v') ? v.slice(1) : v;
  }

  function isRealEndpoint() {
    const header = getHeaderRoot();
    if (!header) return false;
    const method = header.querySelector('[data-testid="http-method"]')?.textContent?.trim().toLowerCase() || '';
    const methodOk = /^(get|post|put|patch|delete|head|options)$/.test(method);
    const hasUrl   = !!header.querySelector('[data-testid="serverurl"], [data-testid="request-url"]');
    return !!(methodOk && (hasUrl || header.hasAttribute('data-raycast-oas')));
  }

  /* ===== NETWORK ===== */
  async function headOk(url, signal) {
    try { const r = await fetch(url, { method: 'HEAD', credentials: 'include', signal }); return r.ok; }
    catch { return false; }
  }
  const absoluteUrl = (u) => { try { return new URL(u, location.origin).href; } catch { return null; } };

  /* ===== FALLBACK: name-match against /openapi index ===== */
  // Used only when data-raycast-oas is absent. Scores each listed spec by how
  // many tokens from the project root path appear in its filename, then picks
  // the best match without fetching any spec content.
  async function findFromOpenapiIndex(signal) {
    try {
      const res = await fetch(`${projectRoot()}/openapi`, { credentials: 'include', signal });
      if (!res.ok) return null;
      const doc = new DOMParser().parseFromString(await res.text(), 'text/html');
      const links = [...doc.querySelectorAll('a[href$=".json"]')].map(a => a.getAttribute('href')).filter(Boolean);
      const tokens = projectRoot().replace(/^\//, '').split(/[-/]+/).filter(t => t.length > 3);
      const best = links
        .map(href => ({ href, score: tokens.reduce((s, t) => s + (href.toLowerCase().includes(t) ? 1 : 0), 0) }))
        .sort((a, b) => b.score - a.score)[0];
      if (!best || best.score === 0) return null;
      const filename = best.href.split('/').pop();
      const url = absoluteUrl(`${projectRoot()}/openapi/${filename}`);
      return url ? { url, downloadUrl: url, filename } : null;
    } catch (e) {
      log('/openapi fallback miss:', e.message);
      return null;
    }
  }

  /* ===== WAIT FOR DOM ===== */
  async function waitForHead(timeoutMs = 3000) {
    if (getHead()) return true;
    return new Promise((resolve) => {
      const obs = new MutationObserver(() => { if (getHead()) { obs.disconnect(); resolve(true); } });
      obs.observe(document.documentElement, { childList: true, subtree: true });
      setTimeout(() => { obs.disconnect(); resolve(!!getHead()); }, timeoutMs);
    });
  }

  /* ===== RUN ===== */
  async function run() {
    if (!isInReference()) { moHead.disconnect(); moSide.disconnect(); moHdr.disconnect(); return; }

    if (!getHead()) {
      if (!(await waitForHead(3000))) { scheduleRun('no-head-yet'); return; }
      if (!getHead()) { scheduleRun('no-head-postwait'); return; }
    }

    bindObservers();

    if (!isRealEndpoint()) { removeSlot(); scheduleRun('await-endpoint-hydration'); return; }

    const start = performance.now();
    while (!getH1() && performance.now() - start < 800) await new Promise(r => requestAnimationFrame(r));

    const ver        = readmeVersion() || 'default';
    const slug       = currentSlug() || '';
    const raycastKey = getHeaderRoot()?.getAttribute('data-raycast-oas') || '';
    const ctxKey     = `${ver}::${slug}::${raycastKey}`;
    const slot       = getSlot();

    if (activeCtxKey === ctxKey && currentAbort && !currentAbort.signal.aborted) { log('dedupe: in-flight'); return; }
    if (ctxKey === lastCtxKey && slot?.querySelector('[data-oas-link],[data-oas-msg]')) { log('skip: already rendered'); return; }
    lastCtxKey = ctxKey;

    if (CACHE.has(ctxKey)) { renderButton(CACHE.get(ctxKey)); return; }

    const myLoadId = ++loadSeq;
    activeCtxKey = ctxKey;
    activeLoadId = myLoadId;
    renderLoading(myLoadId);
    scheduleFallback(myLoadId);
    if (currentAbort) currentAbort.abort();
    currentAbort = new AbortController();
    const { signal } = currentAbort;

    try {
      // Primary: <header data-raycast-oas="..."> is ReadMe's authoritative signal
      // for exactly which spec this page was built from.
      if (raycastKey) {
        const filename   = raycastKey.split('/').pop();
        const openapiUrl = `${projectRoot()}/openapi/${filename}`;
        const url = (await headOk(openapiUrl, signal)) ? openapiUrl : absoluteUrl(raycastKey);
        if (myLoadId !== activeLoadId) return;
        if (url) { const r = { url, downloadUrl: url, filename }; cancelFallback(myLoadId); CACHE.set(ctxKey, r); renderButton(r); }
        return;
      }

      // Fallback: data-raycast-oas absent — name-match against /openapi index.
      const result = await findFromOpenapiIndex(signal);
      if (myLoadId !== activeLoadId) return;
      if (result) { cancelFallback(myLoadId); CACHE.set(ctxKey, result); renderButton(result); }
    } catch (e) {
      log('run error:', e);
    } finally {
      if (activeLoadId === myLoadId) { activeCtxKey = null; activeLoadId = null; }
    }
  }

  /* ===== LIFECYCLE ===== */
  function scheduleRun(why) {
    log('scheduleRun:', why);
    clearTimeout(runTimer);
    runTimer = setTimeout(run, 120);
  }

  const moHead = new MutationObserver((ms) => { if (ms.every(m => !m.target?.closest?.('#oas-slot'))) scheduleRun('mut:head'); });
  const moSide = new MutationObserver(() => scheduleRun('mut:sidebar'));
  const moHdr  = new MutationObserver((ms) => { if (ms.every(m => !m.target?.closest?.('#oas-slot'))) scheduleRun('mut:header'); });

  function bindObservers() {
    moHead.disconnect(); moSide.disconnect(); moHdr.disconnect();
    const head = getHead();
    if (head) moHead.observe(head, { childList: true, subtree: true });
    const side = document.querySelector('#reference-sidebar');
    if (side) moSide.observe(side, { childList: true, subtree: true });
    const hdr = getHeaderRoot();
    // attributes:true catches SPA updates to data-raycast-oas (attribute mutation, not childList)
    if (hdr) moHdr.observe(hdr, { childList: true, subtree: true, attributes: true, attributeFilter: ['data-raycast-oas'] });
  }

  const onPageLoad = () => scheduleRun('pageLoad');
  if (window.jQuery && jQuery(window).on) jQuery(window).on('pageLoad', onPageLoad);
  window.addEventListener('pageLoad', onPageLoad);
  if (document.readyState === 'complete' || document.readyState === 'interactive') onPageLoad();
  else document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', onPageLoad);
  bindObservers();
})();

BodyMarkdown:
Configured Commerce + Product Recommendations                                                           

For AI agents: visit https://docs.developers.optimizely.com/llms.txt for an index of all pages formatted in Markdown and endpoints in OpenAPI.

You can integrate Optimizely Configured Commerce and Optimizely Product Recommendations to increase user conversions.

> 📘
> 
> ### 
> 
> Note
> 
> [](#note)
> 
> Optimizely includes the Product Recommendations JavaScript in the base themes and blueprints. You may need to manually add the `peerius.js` file for custom themes and blueprints.

## 

Generate the Products RSS Feed file in the Admin Console

[](#generate-the-products-rss-feed-file-in-the-admin-console)

1.  Go to the Configured Commerce **Admin Console > Administration > System > Settings**.
    
2.  Click the **Integration** tab, then go to **Integration Connectors**.
    
3.  Toggle **Enable Product Recommendations** to **Yes**. This automatically creates two jobs: **Export Products RSS Feed** and **Export Historical Orders**.
    
    ![Enable Product Recommendations](https://files.readme.io/a5f5b44b47fa9a3f7866ac6d1f23338508fd1bcf786e6481e622ee70a238c1f9-EnableProductRecs-2.png)
    
4.  Go to **Administration > Jobs > Job Definitions**.
    
    ![Export Products RSS Feed Job](https://files.readme.io/8af40765b56ba9c5dd0f6460708a2bce1a3488ac4f3e7f23bbefc27143f4605f-ExportProductsRSSFeed-2.png)
    
5.  Click the **Edit** icon on the **Export Products RSS Feed Job**, and click **More (...)** to schedule the job. Remember to fill in the **Website Name** on the Schedule Job modal. Click **Schedule Job** when finished.
    
    ![Schedule Job](https://files.readme.io/8c57722568a437c9074263205f13ad0c7e63be400bd332841f43259bb4874f71-ScheduleJob-2.png)
    
6.  Go to **Library > Media** after you run the job, and open **UserFiles > \_system > ProductRecommendationFeed**. Ensure that it contains a `Products_RSS_Feed-{WebsiteName}.xml` file with your product data.
    
    ![Product Recommendations Feed](https://files.readme.io/b6def278f8acc789d62eb1d90eb202506fe1c90a958bc295237e1d352a1947bf-ProductRecsFeed-2.png)
    

## 

Import your Products RSS Feed file to the Product Recommendations portal

[](#import-your-products-rss-feed-file-to-the-product-recommendations-portal)

> 📘
> 
> ### 
> 
> Note
> 
> [](#note-1)
> 
> You must work with your onboarding team to complete this step. If you are out of onboarding, email [support@optimizely.com](mailto:support@optimizely.com) and CC your Customer Success Manager.

1.  Go to the Product Recommendations portal and click **Admin > Site Management > Feed configuration > Configure**.
    
2.  Set **Feed type** to **Generic download**.
    
3.  Enter `{your_site_url}/api/v1/productsrssfeed` in the **Feed URL field**.
    
4.  Select your **Default location**. In general, select the language code for the default website language.
    
    ![Configure Feed](https://files.readme.io/aff68ffce687e46f4def186d41a62bdf749a5437000f89daf614b47ad68e88bb-configcommprodrecs5.png)
    
5.  Select the **History** tab and click **Run feed**.
    
    ![Run Feed History](https://files.readme.io/9ee7c287db97bfdef7d8342149c977b0b31006faeb532d9bcea086907b3be519-configcommprodrecs6.png)
    
6.  Select your site from the modal that appears, then click **Run feed** again.
    
    ![Select Site for Feed](https://files.readme.io/1271d035834b8318bbfd7c1d39597ea436aada871232c3097cfe239c7e4ec2ca-configcommprodrecs7.png)
    
7.  Wait for the feed to import successfully. If the import fails, check the error message and contact Optimizely support.
    
8.  Set a schedule for the feed to run. Optimizely recommends having the feed run daily 15-30 minutes after the feed updates from Configured Commerce.
    
    ![Set Schedule](https://files.readme.io/d5a2e6fc4dcc0be7855722abc2f969addd89ce123f965a791638b296d206783a-SetSchedule.png)
    
    ![Schedule Configuration](https://files.readme.io/6845f1c869d23f7223aa64df17626455fd0170a9ea725c14dbac84451de2fb7c-Schedule.png)
    

## 

Configure tracking in the Product Recommendations portal

[](#configure-tracking-in-the-product-recommendations-portal)

> 📘
> 
> ### 
> 
> Note
> 
> [](#note-2)
> 
> You must work with your onboarding team to complete this step. If you are out of onboarding, email [support@optimizely.com](mailto:support@optimizely.com) and CC your Customer Success Manager.

1.  Go to **Admin > Tracking > Domains**.
    
2.  Click **Add Domain** and input your site domain. Do not add `https://` or `www`.
    
    ![Add Domain](https://files.readme.io/5577f672562b80de5363c6bbcf36514ab99e36adec5f8bb1b5e090f5f77ffe0a-AddDomain.png)
    
    ![List of Domains](https://files.readme.io/0e9effbcdb688709e187cf6fa0755c6be130a11d6b09a79853da92143c1fcf27-List_of_Domains.png)
    
    Your domain is now whitelisted and can receive tracking requests.
    
3.  Go to the **Script** tab.
    
4.  Ensure **Tracking script type** is set to **Generic format**.
    

You should now have tracking and your feed setup. These are the two fundamental requirements for Product Recommendations to work. You can now create widgets for the website and adjust the strategies to reflect the recommendations for your customers.

## 

Configure tracking in the Admin Console

[](#configure-tracking-in-the-admin-console)

After creating the feed, you must adjust a few settings to ensure tracking works as intended.

![Product Recommendations Settings](https://files.readme.io/9422a1a7a0abf3a89d0a68b14cc0de03922a2eb1b40a5bd7d6cac05fef2001a7-ProductRecsSettings-2.png)

You should update three areas:

*   **Peerius Tracking URL** — This depends on your environment.
    
    *   **UAT** — `//<sitename>.uat.productrecs.optimizely.com/tracker/peerius.page`
    *   **PROD (SE)** — `//<sitename>.peerius.episerver.net/tracker/peerius.page`
    *   **PROD (US)** — `//<sitename>.uswe01.productrecs.episerver.net/tracker/peerius.page`
*   **Peerius Site Name** — This is the name given to your Product Recommendation instance. You can find this in the Product Recommendatons portal.
    
    ![Peerius Site Name](https://files.readme.io/ed12a3456883e8fbf7b29fa613c118dc104ee72d3ec13756b057aa12cecf06b3-PeeriusSiteName-2.png)
    
    This example has datademosite2 as the Site Name.
    
*   **Peerius API Version** — This should always be **v1\_4**.
    

After saving the settings, check your evironments to see if tracking is live.

1.  Go to your website.
2.  Open up the developer console and go to the **Network** tab.
3.  Search for _peerius_ and hit refresh. You should see `peerius.page`. You can also go to the **Sources** tab and look for `<sitename>.uat.productrecs`, `<sitename>.uswe01`, or `<sitename>.peerius.episerver`. You should see `peerius.page`, `tracker.page`, and `trackerform.page`.

If you do not see tracking, contact your dedicated onboarding team. If you are out of onboarding, email [support@optimizely.com](mailto:support@optimizely.com) and CC your Customer Success Manager.

## 

Configure widgets in the Product Recommendations portal

[](#configure-widgets-in-the-product-recommendations-portal)

1.  Go to the Product Recommendations portal and click **Configuration > Product Recommendations > Widgets** and [create your desired widgets](https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/29276227082893-Manage-widgets).
    
    ![Configure Widgets](https://files.readme.io/e5a08a17ba5ce405c7dc85fa0e90dceba1aa2aba16b8158d60eab2bc54a85ed8-configcommprodrecs8.png)
    
2.  Go to **Widgets per page** and assign widgets to the relevant pages.
    
    ![Widgets per Page](https://files.readme.io/e6d4edaaba35be8edba4bee9f90fe2c1d77370389243b8fc9b1e7b89f4b41588-configcommprodrecs9.png)
    

## 

Configure Recommended Product widgets in Classic CMS

[](#configure-recommended-product-widgets-in-classic-cms)

1.  Go to the Configured Commerce Classic CMS by adding `/contentadmin` to the end of your site URL or by selecting **Content Editor (CMS)** from the Dashboard in the Admin Console.
2.  Click the **Edit** icon.
3.  Select a page in the page tree.
4.  Click **Add Content**.
5.  Select the **Recommended Products** widget.
6.  Choose the **Number of Products to Display**.
7.  Set the **Product Information to Display**, the positioning, or other settings as desired.
8.  Click **Save**, then click **Publish**.

## 

Configure Product Recommendations carousel widgets in Spire CMS

[](#configure-product-recommendations-carousel-widgets-in-spire-cms)

1.  Go to the Configured Commerce Spire CMS by adding `/contentadmin` to the end of your site URL or by selecting **Content Editor (CMS)** from the Dashboard in the Admin Console.
    
2.  Click the **Edit** icon.
    
3.  Select a page in the page tree.
    
4.  Click **Add Widget**, then select [Product Carousel](https://support.optimizely.com/hc/en-us/articles/9478797427725-Common-Elements-widgets#h_01HAW7BJCMMQKABHYAZ14SDD0T).
    
    ![Product Carousel Widget](https://files.readme.io/ababc2cd58eab7de67ede6ab41e0e1dffd703e504300353f5c6aaf048ce396f1-ProductCarouselWidget-2.png)
    
5.  Select **Recommended Products** for **Carousel Type**. You can also change the **Widget Position** if you plan to use several Product Recommendations widgets.
    
    ![Configure Product Carousel](https://files.readme.io/8ed774d0c26e68651cb5395a40cc4022fc2b19d11a5a817a51235b47e1374ca3-configcommprodrecs11.png)
    
6.  Click **Save**, then click **Publish**.
    

> 📘
> 
> ### 
> 
> Note
> 
> [](#note-3)
> 
> If you have multiple widgets on a page, such as on a product detail page, set the second widget's position to **2**.
